subject: [PATCH v9 18/32] fs/proc: account PMD swap entries in smaps

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch updates the Linux kernel's /proc filesystem to correctly account for PMD swap entries in the smaps output. It introduces a new function, smaps_account_swap(), which is called when a swapped-out THP (Transparent Huge Page) is encountered. This function calculates the swap and swap PSS (Proportional Set Size) values based on the number of slots in the PMD entry. The patch also updates the smaps_pte_entry() and smaps_pmd_entry() functions to use this new function when encountering swapped-out THPs. This change ensures that swapped-out THPs are not included in AnonHugePages or Rss, and allows for accurate accounting of swap and swap PSS values.
